concept.ai-hallucination.def: A confident answer that is invented, because the model predicts plausible text rather than verified truth and fills any gap with something that reads right.
concept.ai-grounding.def: Pulling the real source into the context and answering from it - citing it, and allowing "I don't know" - so the answer rests on a checkable fact instead of a guess.
concept.ai-citation.def: Pointing at the exact source a grounded answer came from, so the claim can be traced back and checked.
